 Alan Walker Is Performing at the BMIC 2026 Esports Tournament
 Where are you now?
 By   Aritra Bhowmick   
 Updated: Oct. 27, 2026, 4:06 p.m. 
 Related reads: Google Launches Google Play Arena, Its Own Mobile Gaming Tournament Featuring Six Games 
 Krafton India, in partnership with District, has announced that theglobal electronic music star Alan Walker will perform at the Battlegrounds Mobile India International Cup (BMIC) 2026. More like this BGMI Survivor League Brings 50 Creators Together in 30-Day Competition Featuring ₹70 Lakh Prize Pool 
The performance is scheduled for the opening day of BMIC on October 30, 2026, at the Dome, SVP Indoor Stadium (NSCI), Mumbai. Alan Walker previously collaborated with BGMI in 2024, when his track "Hero" was introduced in the game through the "Be A Hero" campaign, welcoming players to the BGMI lobby.
 Running from October 30 to November 1, BMIC 2026 will feature 16 teams competing for a ₹1 crore prize pool and qualification slots for the Global Championship 2026. Of these, six teams will represent India, while five each will come from Korea and Japan.
 Users interested in attending BMIC 2026 can book their tickets through District, with prices starting at ₹499.
 Meanwhile, Kraftons’s BGMI Survivor League is underway , featuring 50 established and emerging content creators for a 30-day competition. The competition also allows players to support their favourite creators directly in the game. 
 In other news, Krafton India has launched Battlin , a unified gaming tournament platform that brings tournament discovery, registration, participation, and more into one place.
